import limited_client as r, numpy as np
obs=r.observe(2)
D=obs['depth_m']; K=obs['intrinsic']; T=obs['camera_to_world']
for name,(u,v) in {'stem_near_mid':(395,239),'stem_mid':(390,237),'stem_near_head':(417,246),'tulip_head':(444,255),'vase_opening':(108,269),'table_center':(260,340),'tcp_pixel':(260,270)}.items():

print('robot',obs['robot']); print('status',r.status())

steps.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import limited_client as r, numpy as np
J=np.array([[-.214,-.003,-.193,-.022,-.203,-.009,.002],[-.026,.072,-.032,.136,-.033,.185,-.023],[-.058,-.289,-.063,.457,-.061,.011,-.061]])
o=r.observe(2)
print('start tcp',o['robot']['tcp_position'],'status',r.status())
t=np.array([-.30,-.12,1.02])
for k in range(6):
 o=r.observe(); p=np.array(o['robot']['tcp_position']); q=np.array(o['robot']['joint_positions'])
 e=t-p; d=e*min(1.,.035/max(np.linalg.norm(e),1e-9))
 dq=np.linalg.pinv(J)@d
 m=np.max(np.abs(dq))
 if m>.065: dq*=.065/m
 a=np.r_[q+dq,[.04,.04]]
 res=r.step(a); n=r.observe(); print('iter',k,'err',np.round(e,3),'dq',np.round(dq,3),'tcp',np.round(n['robot']['tcp_position'],3),'actions',res['actions'])
 if res.get('ended') or np.linalg.norm(t-np.array(n['robot']['tcp_position']))<.06: break
print('final robot',r.observe()['robot']); print('status',r.status())

import limited_client as r, numpy as np
J=np.array([[-.204,.134,-.263,-.248,.032,.043,.106],[-.439,-.320,-.484,.354,-.190,.036,-.172],[-.164,-.397,-.115,.062,-.147,-.186,-.165]])
t=np.array([-.34,-.05,.85])
for k in range(8):
 o=r.observe(); p=np.array(o['robot']['tcp_position'],float); q=np.array(o['robot']['joint_positions'],float); e=t-p
 d=e*min(1.,.012/max(np.linalg.norm(e),1e-9))
 dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+.004*np.eye(3),d)
 m=np.max(np.abs(dq))
 if m>.035: dq*=.035/m
 res=r.step(np.r_[q+dq,[.04,.04]])
 n=r.observe(); print(k,'err',np.round(e,3),'dq',np.round(dq,3),'tcp',np.round(n['robot']['tcp_position'],3),'actions',res['actions'])
 if res.get('ended') or np.linalg.norm(t-np.array(n['robot']['tcp_position']))<.035: break
x=r.observe(2); print('final robot',x['robot']); print('status',r.status())

import limited_client as robot, numpy as np
cols=[]
for j in range(7):
    o=robot.observe(2); q=np.array(o['robot']['joint_positions'],float); p=np.array(o['robot']['tcp_position'],float)

print('J',np.array(cols).T.tolist())
for cam in (2,3):
    x=robot.observe(cam); print('camera',cam,'robot',x['robot'],'status',robot.status())
